== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Death Star II)]] (<code>1261_24</code>), showing the '''Original''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009; slip #23).
* '''Original text:''' “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
